examples.text: Купи хлеб, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Buy some bread, please.

meanings.note: Manner or predicative adverb in '-о' derived from the corresponding adjective stem, used in everyday speech to mean 'may'.

examples.text: А заготовщиком можно и полгода пробыть.
examples.trans: And you can stay a prep cook for half a year.

examples.text: Можно в сауну сходить.
examples.trans: We could go to a sauna together.

examples.text: А потом куплю тебе машину. Можно я вернусь?
examples.trans: And then I will buy you a car. May I come back?

meanings.note: Manner or predicative adverb in '-о' derived from the corresponding adjective stem, used in everyday speech to mean 'only'.

examples.text: У вас только две кухни на выбор.
examples.trans: You have only two kitchens to choose from.

examples.text: Можно. Только теперь простым поваром.
examples.trans: You may. Only now as a regular line cook.

examples.text: Я только посмотрел.
examples.trans: I was only looking.

meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'now'.

examples.text: Можно. Только теперь простым поваром.
examples.trans: You may. Only now as a regular line cook.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник.
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss.

examples.text: Теперь всё хорошо.
examples.trans: Now everything's fine.

meanings.note: Descriptive Russian adjective meaning 'simple', agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Можно. Только теперь простым поваром.
examples.trans: You may. Only now as a regular line cook.

examples.text: Простым поваром я дольше тебе на машину буду зарабатывать.
examples.trans: As a regular cook it will take me longer to earn enough for your car.

examples.text: Это простой вопрос.
examples.trans: That's a simple question.

meanings.note: Declinable masculine noun meaning 'cook', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Что я ни фига не повар.
examples.trans: That I am not a cook at all.

examples.text: Дело в том, что Денис не повар.
examples.trans: The thing is that Denis is not a cook.

examples.text: Для такого повара, как ты, я найду наказание похуже.
examples.trans: For a cook like you, I will find a worse punishment.

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'take', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Простым поваром я дольше тебе на машину буду зарабатывать.
examples.trans: As a regular cook it will take me longer to earn enough for your car.

examples.text: Рад снова видеть тебя на воле, с чистой совестью.
examples.trans: Glad to see you free again, with a clear conscience.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'рабатывать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to car'.

examples.text: Простым поваром я дольше тебе на машину буду зарабатывать.
examples.trans: As a regular cook it will take me longer to earn enough for your car.

examples.text: Рад снова видеть тебя на воле, с чистой совестью.
examples.trans: Glad to see you free again, with a clear conscience.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronoun ('nothing') that declines for case depending on its grammatical function in the sentence.

examples.text: Да пока ты на складе, никто ничего не поймёт.
examples.trans: As long as you are in the storage room, nobody will figure anything out.

examples.text: Ничего не трогает.
examples.trans: He is not touching anything.

examples.text: Поверьте, ничто так не сближает.
examples.trans: Believe me, nothing brings people closer like that.

торопиться.gloss: to be in a hurry, to hurry

meanings.en: to be in a hurry, to hurry
meanings.note: Russian imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to be in a hurry', forming an aspectual pair with 'поторопиться'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.text: Ничего, я не тороплюсь.
examples.trans: That is alright, I am in no hurry.

examples.text: Извините, тороплюсь.
examples.trans: Sorry, I'm in a hurry.

examples.text: Не торопись!
examples.trans: Don't rush!
